integrity: Analytic theorem with independently compared finite Kraus and Wigner expressions and diagnostic numerical quadrature. The code is evidence for finite checks, not a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Pure one-mode input states with finite nonzero Fock cutoff, vacuum-environment loss, fixed state at threshold; nonuniform under root splitting. Prior 50-percent pointwise threshold and stellar representation are not claimed new. Independent priority validation not performed.
title: Stellar-root multiplicity sets the Wigner-negativity onset exponent under pure loss
